0022600035.text: The Milwaukee Bucks (1-11) visit the Orlando Magic (3-7) for the Bucks' 13th game of the 2026-27 season, with Milwaukee on an eight-game losing streak, 0-5 on the road, 15th in the East, and 7 games back in the Central, while Orlando has won its last game, is 0-4 at home, and sits 12th in the East and 3 games back in the Southeast. Milwaukee is without Myles Turner (out, rest) and Ryan Rollins (day-to-day, head, game-time decision), and Orlando is missing Izaiyah Nelson (out, ankle surgery), Jalen Suggs (out, knee), Jamal Cain (out, shoulder bruise), Jonathan Isaac (out, knee), Noah Penda (out, hamstring strain), Paolo Banchero (out, ankle sprain), and Tristan da Silva (out, calf strain). The teams have not played each other yet in 2026-27, while in 2025-26 the Bucks lost the season series 1-2, and their most recent meeting was a 130-91 Bucks loss in Milwaukee on March 8, 2026.
